data.description:
S5 completion-verifier FAIL on DD1+DD5. The _phase_source_branch_version_bump function exists in merge-to-main-pr.sh but is never called in the production pipeline — it is dead code. A fix commit 37430025d7 exists on another branch with the full integration, but we should add the minimal call here directly.

## Fix
Add a call to _phase_source_branch_version_bump in _phase_merge BEFORE the PR push step (the gh pr create / git push -u origin line).

## File
plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh — _phase_merge function (around line 2384)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] _phase_merge calls _phase_source_branch_version_bump before gh pr create / git push -u
  Verify: grep -A30 '_phase_merge()' plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh | grep -E '_phase_source_branch_version_bump|source.branch.*bump' | head -3
- [ ] test-merge-to-main-pr.sh suite still passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] No regression on existing 156 tests
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-resume-and-stale.sh && bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-story-base.sh
data.title: S5 remediation: wire _phase_source_branch_version_bump into _phase_merge
